title: Turn a messy doc into a clean draft
goal: You will transform messy meeting notes into a structured document tailored to your intended audience and verify its accuracy and tone.
prerequisites: Meeting notes with confidential details removed
A known audience and purpose for the document

steps.action: Start a new conversation in ChatGPT.
steps.why: A fresh conversation keeps unrelated context out of the document.
steps.checkpoint: You should see an empty chat with a message box at the bottom.
hint_levels: Look near the top of the left sidebar.
Find the button labeled New chat.
Click New chat in the left sidebar.

steps.action: Tell ChatGPT the document's audience, purpose, and desired tone.
steps.where: Message box at the bottom of the new chat.
steps.why: Clear context helps the response sound appropriate to its readers.
steps.checkpoint: The message box should contain a sentence naming the audience, purpose, and tone.
hint_levels: Describe who will read the result and why.
Include an audience such as executives, a purpose such as deciding next steps, and a tone such as concise and professional.
Type: "The audience is [audience], the purpose is [purpose], and the tone should be [tone]."

steps.action: Paste the meeting notes beneath your audience instructions.
steps.where: Same message box, on a new line below the context sentence.
steps.why: The notes provide the source material that ChatGPT will organize.
steps.checkpoint: You should see your complete notes in the message box below the audience instructions.
hint_levels: Add the source material after your context.
Start a new line, label it Meeting notes, and paste all relevant notes.
Press Shift+Enter, type "Meeting notes:", press Shift+Enter again, then press Ctrl+V on Windows or Command+V on macOS.

steps.action: Add instructions to organize the notes into a summary, decisions, action items, owners, deadlines, and open questions without inventing details.
steps.where: Message box, on a new line after the pasted notes.
steps.why: A named structure produces a usable document and limits unsupported additions.
steps.checkpoint: You should see every requested section and the no-invention rule in your draft prompt.
hint_levels: Specify the headings the finished document needs.
Request Summary, Decisions, Action Items, Owners, Deadlines, and Open Questions, and require unknown information to be marked.
Type: "Organize these notes into Summary, Decisions, Action Items with owners and deadlines, and Open Questions. Do not invent facts; mark missing details as Not specified."

steps.where: Up-arrow "Send message" button at the right edge of the message box.
steps.why: Sending the prompt generates the first structured draft.
steps.checkpoint: You should see a response containing headings and organized meeting information.
hint_levels: Use the control beside the message box.
The Send message button appears as an up arrow when text is ready.
Click the up-arrow Send message button, or press Enter.

steps.action: Compare the generated draft with your original notes for factual accuracy.
steps.where: Chat conversation area, comparing the assistant response with the notes in your earlier message.
steps.why: Reviewing catches invented, omitted, or misassigned information before sharing.
steps.checkpoint: You should be able to point to a matching source note for every decision, owner, and deadline in the draft.
hint_levels: Focus first on details that could change what someone does.
Check every decision, person, date, number, and action item against the pasted notes.
Scroll between your notes and the response, and list any unsupported or missing details in the message box.

steps.action: Request one revision that corrects any factual issues and better matches the intended tone.
steps.where: Message box below the assistant's draft.
steps.why: Targeted feedback turns the first draft into an accurate audience-ready version.
steps.checkpoint: You should see a revised document with your corrections applied and the requested tone reflected.
hint_levels: Tell ChatGPT exactly what must change.
Name incorrect or missing details and describe the tone adjustment using concrete words such as warmer, shorter, or more formal.
Type your corrections plus "Revise the full document for a [tone] tone for [audience], keeping all facts unchanged," then press Enter.

steps.action: Ask ChatGPT to flag any remaining unclear details instead of guessing.
steps.where: Message box below the revised response.
steps.why: Explicit uncertainty makes the document safer to finalize and share.
steps.checkpoint: You should see either a list of unclear details or a statement that none remain.
hint_levels: Look for anything the notes did not settle.
Request a short uncertainty check covering owners, deadlines, decisions, and ambiguous wording.
Type: "List any remaining unclear or unsupported details in this document; do not guess," then press Enter.

steps.action: Copy the final structured document for use in your destination document app.
steps.where: Final assistant response, "Copy" button beneath the response.
steps.why: Copying preserves the finished structure so you can save or share it.
steps.checkpoint: You should see a copied confirmation on the response and be able to paste the document with its headings intact.
hint_levels: Use the response action that places its text on the clipboard.
The Copy button appears beneath the assistant's response, sometimes as overlapping rectangles.
Move the pointer beneath the final response, click Copy, then press Ctrl+V on Windows or Command+V on macOS in your destination document.
